name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 deadline is confirmed. Admission model was not established. Department and central pages disagree on English minima and insurance support; safer English scores and both support descriptions are retained.

deadlines.label: Complete Fall 2027 application and official English scores

english.toefl: 96 or greater on department FAQ; central Biology table gives 90 old scale / 4.5 new scale
english.note: Department FAQ requires IELTS 7, TOEFL 96 and DET 120; current central Biology table instead lists IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 90 old scale or 4.5 new scale and DET 115. Higher stated scores retained; confirm the conflict. Central US-degree/citizenship exemptions exist and are managed by Graduate Student Affairs. Official scores due by the program deadline.

applicationFee.note: No application fee; no waiver needed.

documents: Unofficial undergraduate and graduate transcripts; official copies after accepting admission
Statement of purpose covering research preparation, research interests/groups, and long-term goals
Official English scores for applicable international applicants
requirements.note: Bachelor degree sufficient; no standard GPA minimum. Prior advisor commitment not required. Research groups of interest should be discussed in the statement.

funding.note: Department states all PhD candidates in good standing receive a 12-month stipend, tuition remission, basic health insurance and applicable dependent allowance; minimum three semesters as a teaching assistant. Central page instead gives an undated $46,000 and a two-thirds health-plan contribution. Confirm the current offer; future rate not established.
